product.title: Everglades to Keys: Florida's Ultimate National Parks Expedition
product.description: Travel from Miami through South Florida's unique ecosystems on an expedition-style day that connects the Everglades region and the Florida Keys. This route blends wildlife, scenery, and nature-focused stops.
highlights: National parks-focused Florida adventure from Miami
Visit multiple natural landscapes in one itinerary
Great for wildlife and nature enthusiasts

meetingPoint.description: Downtown Miami pickup details are provided before departure.

itineraryItems.title: Depart Miami
itineraryItems.description: Begin with a guided transfer toward South Florida parks.

itineraryItems.title: Everglades region exploration
itineraryItems.description: Experience wetlands and wildlife viewing opportunities.

itineraryItems.title: Florida Keys segment
itineraryItems.description: Continue south for coastal scenery and nature interpretation.

faqs.question: What kind of tour is this?
faqs.answer: It is a full-day expedition connecting the Everglades and the Keys.
